sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:182

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 14:182:1
items.html: Their surrounding light is outside of them, like the fourth discernment of ZA; and afterwards they entered into the spaces of the Galgalta of the Nukva, etc., which is the fifth discernment, etc. The matter of these six discernments has already been explained above, that they apply in AVI, in ZA and in the Nukva. See there.
